method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_apy
tools.title: Get APY
tools.description: Current annualized yield (APY) for Re's yield-bearing stablecoins reUSD and reUSDe, computed from NAV growth over a lookback window (default 7 days). Returns the APY percentage plus current and past NAV per token.

tokens.description: Comma-separated token filter: reUSD, reUSDe or reUSD,reUSDe (default: both)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Get price history
tools.description: Daily token price (NAV) history for reUSD and reUSDe, each day with its price and trailing 7-day APY. By default returns the full history; period limits how far back it goes.

tokens.description: Comma-separated token filter: reUSD, reUSDe or reUSD,reUSDe (default: both)

tools.name: get_supply
tools.title: Get token supply
tools.description: Total and circulating on-chain supply of reUSD and reUSDe, as full-precision decimal strings. Omit token to get both.

tools.name: get_tvl
tools.title: Get TVL
tools.description: Re Protocol TVL metrics in USD: per-product TVL (reusd, reusde), protocol totals (total, onchain_capital, offchain_capital), and premium-receivables (outstanding insurance premiums owed to Re, updated quarterly). Omit metric to get all of them.

tools.name: get_tvl_history
tools.title: Get TVL history
tools.description: Daily history of Re Protocol TVL metrics in USD: per-product TVL (reusd, reusde), protocol totals (total, onchain_capital, offchain_capital), and premium-receivables. By default returns the full history; period limits how far back it goes. Omit metric to get all of them.

tools.name: get_points_opportunities
tools.title: Get points opportunities
tools.description: Live Re Points earning opportunities: every strategy (Curve/Pendle LPs, lending collateral, direct holdings, ...) that earned points on the latest day, with its boost multiplier, daily points, TVL, holders and start/end dates. Also includes Pendle PT holdings (0 multiplier, TVL only) and, under `ended`, strategies whose points program has ended.

season.description: Points season, e.g. 1 or 2 (default: current season)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Re docs
tools.description: Search the Re Protocol documentation (docs.re.xyz) for concepts, product guides, FAQs, tokenomics, points mechanics and how-tos. Returns relevant excerpts with page links. Use get_doc_page to read a full page.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'how does the reUSDe redemption queue work'

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.title: Get docs page
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Re Protocol documentation page by URL. Use list_docs or search_docs to find page URLs.

url.description: Docs page URL (e.g. https://docs.re.xyz/getting-started-with-re/faq) or site-relative path (/getting-started-with-re/faq)

tools.name: list_docs
tools.title: List docs pages
tools.description: Table of contents of the Re Protocol documentation: every page with its title, URL and short description. Useful for browsing before fetching a specific page.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.title: Get wallet balance
tools.description: A wallet's direct reUSD/reUSDe holdings across all chains (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Base, ...), valued in USD at current NAV. Returns per-token and per-chain balances plus a combined USD total. Direct token holdings only — LP and derivative positions are not included.

tools.name: get_wallet_points
tools.title: Get wallet points
tools.description: A wallet's accumulated Re Points for a season: cumulative points, leaderboard rank, share of total points, and the last day points were earned. Unknown wallets return zero points.

season.description: Points season, e.g. 1 or 2 (default: current season)

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: Recent posts from the Re Protocol blog (re.xyz/insights), newest first: product updates, ecosystem news and press announcements. Filter by tag 'announcements' for press releases. Use get_blog_post to read a full post.

tag.description: Filter by tag slug, e.g. announcements

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.title: Get blog post
tools.description: Full content of a Re Protocol blog post by slug, as plain text, with title, authors, tags, dates and its canonical re.xyz URL for citation.

slug.description: Post slug, as returned by list_blog_posts

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get points leaderboard
tools.description: Public Re Points leaderboard: top wallets (truncated for privacy) ranked by cumulative points, plus total points awarded.
